fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.reason: packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:230 the PR edits the hard-coded 'Notes have been hidden by the organizer' string (spelling only) and keeps the existing '// TODO: i18n this string?'. The untranslated text is real but pre-dates the PR and has no behavioural impact beyond localization.
fix-handle-collective-multiple-host-on-d.comment: The hidden-notes placeholder written into calendar events is a hard-coded English string not routed through i18n.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.reason: apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx:26-29 (new) checks uniqueness with new Set(emails), case-sensitively; addGuests.handler.ts:71-77 lowercases the blacklist but compares guest and attendee emails without normalizing, so case variants of the same address pass as distinct guests.
add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.comment: Guest email uniqueness is checked case-sensitively, so case variants of the same address are accepted as distinct guests (and slip past the lowercased blacklist).

oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.reason: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8-14 indeed calls fetch with no AbortSignal, but this is a hardening suggestion about a hypothetical hanging sync endpoint, not a defect observed in the code.
oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.comment: The fetch to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT has no timeout, so a hanging endpoint could block calendar/video requests.

oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.reason: refreshOAuthTokens.ts:5 uses truthiness of userId, but user ids are autoincrement primary keys starting at 1, so userId 0 never occurs; the guard only distinguishes null team credentials.
oauth-credential-sync-and-app-integratio.comment: The truthy userId check treats user id 0 as absent and skips the credential sync endpoint.

sms-workflow-reminder-retry-count-tracki.reason: scheduleSMSReminders.ts:189-198 the catch increments retryCount for any error in the try block, as claimed, but counting any failure to schedule a reminder toward the retry limit is the intended retry-tracking behaviour; a reminder that fails setup repeatedly also cannot be sent.
sms-workflow-reminder-retry-count-tracki.comment: The catch block increments retryCount for any error, including setup failures unrelated to Twilio, which can delete reminders prematurely.

sms-workflow-reminder-retry-count-tracki.reason: scheduleSMSReminders.ts:199 console.log(`Error scheduling SMS with error ${error}`) is pre-existing and unchanged by the PR, which only adds the retryCount update above it.
sms-workflow-reminder-retry-count-tracki.comment: The catch block logs the raw SMS provider error, which may leak phone numbers or message bodies into logs.

feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.reason: insightsBooking.ts:100-112 uses truthiness for eventTypeId/memberUserId, but these are autoincrement database ids that start at 1; id 0 never reaches this code, and the old Prisma version used the same checks.
feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.comment: Truthiness checks on eventTypeId and memberUserId ignore a filter value of 0.

feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.reason: insightsBooking.ts:149 builds teamIds = [options.orgId, ...teamsFromOrg.map(...)], so the array always contains orgId and is never empty; the claimed empty-array type-inference error cannot happen.
feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.comment: buildOrgAuthorizationCondition passes an empty teamIds array to ANY() when the org has no child teams, causing a PostgreSQL error.

feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.reason: insightsBooking.ts:29-34 the PR adds InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions with teamId optional and makes the constructor accept it (line 58), replacing the discriminated union type. A team-scope call without teamId now compiles, fails safeParse (line 61-62), and silently returns the 1=0 condition with no error.
feat-convert-insightsbookingservice-to-u.comment: The new public options type makes teamId optional for team scope, so a missing teamId compiles and silently yields empty insights instead of a type error.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.reason: config/site_settings.yml in this PR defines embed_by_username: '' (string default), so SiteSetting.embed_by_username is never nil and lib/topic_retriever.rb:48 ''.downcase cannot raise NoMethodError; a blank username just finds no user and returns.
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.comment: fetch_http calls SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase without a presence check, raising NoMethodError when the setting is blank.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.reason: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 calls SimpleRSS.parse open(url) (not .read) without explicit timeouts in an hourly background job with retry disabled; open-uri/Net::HTTP already apply a read timeout. This is a hardening suggestion, not a defect.
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.comment: poll_feed opens the feed URL without a timeout and imports every item without a cap, so a slow or huge feed can tie up a worker.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.reason: spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:9-24 stub embeddable_host and exercise the real invalid_host?; if invalid_host? always returned false, retrieved_recently? would be false on first call (setnx succeeds), perform_retrieve would be called and the .never expectation would fail. The claim that a bug in invalid_host? cannot fail these tests is false.
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.comment: The TopicRetriever specs mock perform_retrieve, so a bug in invalid_host? would not make them fail.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.reason: spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:40-52 set expectations (retriever.expects(:retrieve), TopicView.expects(:new).with(123,...)) that fail if the controller stops making those calls, and the after block asserts success and X-Frame-Options. Asking for template assertions is a test-strengthening suggestion, not a broken test.
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.comment: The EmbedController success tests only assert that mocks are called and would pass even if the controller logic were removed.

enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.reason: spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb tests the execute guards it was written for; poll_feed itself has no spec. That is missing coverage, not a test that fails to verify its stated behaviour.
enhance-embed-url-handling-and-validatio.comment: poll_feed has no test of feed parsing or TopicEmbed.import; the specs only check the execute guards.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb creates embeddable_hosts with no index on host, and app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 queries lower(host) = ?. The table holds a handful of admin-configured hosts, so the missing index is a micro-optimisation.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: record_for_host queries lower(host) on embeddable_hosts, which has no index on host.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: app/models/topic_embed.rb:36-43 now passes category: eh.try(:category_id), which is nil when no host matches; PostCreator then uses the uncategorized category, which is exactly the fallback the comment proposes. embed_category was migrated into per-host categories by the PR's migration, so this is intended.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: TopicEmbed.import passes a nil category when no embeddable host matches the URL, dropping the old embed_category default.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:25 uses category_id.blank?; category ids start at 1 and the value comes from request params, so a meaningful category id 0 cannot occur.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: save_host replaces category_id 0 with the uncategorized category because it uses blank? instead of nil?.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb:23 is describe 'allows_embeddable_host' while the method under test is EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:20). Test naming only; it does not break anything.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: The describe block is named allows_embeddable_host but tests host_allowed?.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: embeddable-host.hbs:3 placeholder="example.com" is an example domain, not translatable prose, so there is nothing to localize.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: The host input placeholder 'example.com' is hard-coded instead of using I18n.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb only asserts the controller subclasses Admin::AdminController, which is what the test claims to check (admin-only access). The absence of action specs is missing coverage, not a broken test.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: The EmbeddableHostsController spec only checks inheritance and does not exercise create, update or destroy.

feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.reason: spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb only asserts the controller subclasses Admin::AdminController, as its test name says. Missing coverage of show/update is not a test that fails to verify its stated behaviour.
feature-can-edit-category-host-relations.comment: The EmbeddingController spec only checks inheritance and does not exercise show or update.

optimize-header-layout-performance-with-.reason: topic-post.scss:264-273 the PR makes .small-action a flex container, so the existing float: left on its .topic-avatar child is now ignored. Dead CSS with no visual effect.
optimize-header-layout-performance-with-.comment: After .small-action becomes a flex container, float: left on .topic-avatar is dead CSS.

feature-automatically-downsize-large-ima.reason: uploads_controller.rb:67 calls OptimizedImage.downsize(tempfile.path, tempfile.path, ...) as claimed, but ImageMagick convert decodes the whole input before writing the output, so in-place conversion to the same path does not corrupt the file.
feature-automatically-downsize-large-ima.comment: Downsizing uses the same path as input and output for ImageMagick convert, which can corrupt or truncate the upload.

fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.reason: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:37 reads params[:alias_level], which is a string from the request ('0'); '0'.present? is true (and even Integer 0.present? is true in Ruby), so selecting 'nobody' updates alias_level to 0.
fix-proper-handling-of-group-memberships.comment: params[:alias_level].present? is false for 0, so choosing the 'nobody' alias level is ignored.

feature-localization-fallbacks-server-si.reason: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12-24 FallbackLocaleList < Hash overrides only [] and stores nothing, as claimed, but I18n::Backend::Fallbacks only calls I18n.fallbacks[locale]; the problem is limited to hypothetical future callers that iterate it.
feature-localization-fallbacks-server-si.comment: FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash but leaves it empty, so iterating I18n.fallbacks returns nothing.

anonymous-add-configurable-device-limit-.reason: anonstore/database.go:18 ErrDeviceLimitReached is a Go sentinel error checked with errors.Is in client.go:45; backend error values are not translated through i18n in Grafana, so there is no defect.
anonymous-add-configurable-device-limit-.comment: The 'device limit reached' error string is hard-coded English and bypasses i18n.

plugins-chore-renamed-instrumentation-mi.reason: metrics_middleware.go QueryData/CallResource calling pluginTarget in both instrumentPluginRequestSize and instrumentPluginRequest is pre-existing; the PR only renames InstrumentationMiddleware to MetricsMiddleware and removes the contextual logger, leaving this logic unchanged.
plugins-chore-renamed-instrumentation-mi.comment: QueryData and CallResource look up the plugin in the registry twice per request.

dual-storage-architecture-grafana-codex#.reason: dualwriter_mode3.go:50-167 does spawn a goroutine per write with a 10s timeout, as claimed, but each goroutine is bounded by that timeout and by the write rate of the API; unbounded fan-out under high throughput is speculative, not an observed defect.
dual-storage-architecture-grafana-codex#.comment: Every mode-3 write spawns an unbounded goroutine for the legacy store, risking goroutine and memory growth under load.

notification-rule-processing-engine-graf.reason: GrafanaGroupLoader.tsx:71 key={promRule.uid}; the previous code keyed by rulerRule.grafana_alert.uid, the same rule uid, which is unique. The comment itself flags no defect.
notification-rule-processing-engine-graf.comment: Using promRule.uid as React key could clash if uids are not unique within a group.

notification-rule-processing-engine-graf.reason: public/app/features/alerting/unified/hooks/useAbilities.ts:289 the PR adds a stray '// duplicate' comment next to useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(rule). Leftover comment, no behavioural effect.
notification-rule-processing-engine-graf.comment: A stray '// duplicate' comment was left next to useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(rule) in useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities.

fix-concurrent-group-access-to-prevent-n.reason: GroupTest.java:137-149 the reader thread catches Exception, as claimed, but it only performs admin REST calls with no assertions; a server-side NPE surfaces as a RuntimeException that is caught and asserted. An Error such as AssertionError cannot arise there, so nothing realistic is masked.
fix-concurrent-group-access-to-prevent-n.comment: The reader thread catches only Exception, so Errors thrown during concurrent reads are swallowed and the test passes anyway.
